item.title: Talbot County Invites Community to Participate in Talbot Day 2026 Poster Contest
item.description: Talbot County is gearing up for the 2026 Talbot Day Celebration, and the community is invited to engage in two longtime traditions: the Talbot Day Poster Contest and the Talbot Citizen & Service Awards.

item.title: Hello Beautiful Film Screening
item.description: Hello Beautiful is an inspiring story of resilience in the face of breast cancer.

item.title: The Books I Almost Didn’t Finish (But I’m Glad I Did)
item.description: Not every book pulls you in immediately. Some take their time. Some feel dense. Some make you wonder if you’re just not in the right mood — or not the right reader. Here are five books I almost set aside — but didn’t. And I’m grateful I stayed.

item.title: United Bankshares Declares First Quarter Dividend
item.description: United is one of only two major banking companies in the USA to have increased its dividend to shareholders for at least 52 consecutive years.

item.title: Announcing the 2026 Annapolis Baygrass Music Festival Lineup
item.description: This year's Annapolis Baygrass Music Festival returns to September 19 & 20, 2026 at Sandy Point State Park in Annapolis, MD with a lineup that will "have us dancing in the sand all weekend!"

item.title: Top Dentists 2026 Survey
item.description: Welcome to the 2026 What’s Up? Top Dentists Peer Review Survey. At What’s Up? Media, we believe there is great value to our readers in a peer review survey.

item.title: When it comes to grief, for children, the play is the thing
item.description: Children don’t grieve the way adults do. They move in and out of grief. A child may become quieter, more withdrawn or have emotional outbursts that seem to come out of nowhere.

item.title: Event Picks for March 2026
item.description: A list of our favorite events around Annapolis, Eastern Shore and beyond for the month of March. Event dates may be subject to change.

item.title: At St. John’s College, the Art Experience Begins With Questions
item.description: Winds of change are bringing fresh air to the Elizabeth Myers Mitchell Art Museum at St. John’s College.

item.title: Ringing in the Wedding: Grayson & Caroline
item.description: Caroline and Grayson embraced a winter wonderland theme for their New Year’s Eve wedding at Severna Park United Methodist Church and The Westin Annapolis.
